import json, random, subprocess, time, copy
from pathlib import Path
random.seed(83270)

def hx(x): return f'{x:032x}'
def run(ops, cases=None):
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','run.py'],input=json.dumps({'cases':cases or [{'ops':ops}]}).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode==0,(p.returncode,p.stderr[:2000])
    r=json.loads(p.stdout)
    assert 'error' not in r,r
    return r['results'][0] if cases is None else r['results']

def expected(routes,qs):
    routes=sorted(routes.items(),key=lambda z:-z[0][1])
    return [next((h for (p,l),h in routes if x>>(128-l)==p>>(128-l)),None) for x in qs]

# Every length/fragment boundary, same normalized route in many host-bit forms,
# cross-owner BMPs, nested routes, shared local patterns, and all key values.
for round in range(18):
    routes={}; ops=[]; probes=[]
    anchors=[random.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(8)]
    for i in range(1500):
        if round%3==0:
            l=random.randrange(129); x=random.choice(anchors)
        elif round%3==1:
            l=random.randrange(129);x=random.getrandbits(128)
        else:
            l=random.randrange(65,129);x=(anchors[0]&(~((1<<64)-1)))|random.getrandbits(64)
        norm=(x>>(128-l))<<(128-l)
        h=random.randrange(4194303);routes[norm,l]=h
        if len(routes)>8192:raise AssertionError
        ops.append(['put',hx(x),l,h])
        if i%100==0:probes.append(x)
    qs=anchors+[x for x,l in routes]+[random.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(300)]
    # probe routes plus randomized host bits under represented prefixes
    qs += [x|random.getrandbits(128-l) for x,l in routes]
    want=expected(routes,qs)
    ops.extend([['save'],['load_saved',0],['query',list(map(hx,qs))],['image_query',list(map(hx,qs))]])
    got=run(ops)
    assert got['loads']==[True], ('save rejected',round)
    assert got['answers']==want+want,('round',round)
print('random boundary/owner/branch tests passed')

# isolation, snapshots, empty replacement, equal-depth fallback updates
ops=[];routes={};want=[];qs=list(map(hx,[0,1,2,3,1<<127,(1<<128)-1]))
for i,(x,l,h) in enumerate([(0,128,3),(0,0,0),(0,128,4194302)]):
    ops += [['put',hx(x),l,h],['save'],['load_saved',i],['query',qs],['image_query',qs]]
    routes[x,l]=h; now=expected(routes,list(map(lambda z:int(z,16),qs)));want+=now+now
ops += [['load_saved',0],['image_query',qs]];want += [3,None,None,None,None,None]
empty=dict(root=None,front16=[],front64=[],cells=[0]*11,banks=[[]for _ in range(11)],bitmaps=[],nexthops=[])
ops += [['load',empty],['image_query',qs]];want += [None]*len(qs)
got=run(ops);assert got['answers']==want and all(got['loads'])
print('isolation passed')

# All 4096 front tags in both layers, with collisions in old software hashing.
routes={};ops=[]
for i in range(4096):
    x=(i<<112)|(0xabcd<<96)
    routes[x,32]=i;ops.append(['put',hx(x),32,i])
    x=(0xffff000000000000|i)<<64 | (1<<63)
    routes[x,65]=4194302-i;ops.append(['put',hx(x),65,4194302-i])
qs=[x for x,l in routes]; want=expected(routes,qs)
ops += [['save'],['load_saved',0],['query',list(map(hx,qs))],['image_query',list(map(hx,qs))]]
t=time.monotonic();got=run(ops)
assert got['loads']==[True] and got['answers']==want+want
print('8192 prefixes / 8192 fronts passed in',time.monotonic()-t)

# Largest live update stream and query stream with no state-growth on updates.
ops=[]
for i in range(131072):ops.append(['put',hx(i),0,i%4194303])
qs=[hx(random.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(65536)]
ops += [['save'],['load_saved',0],['query',qs],['image_query',qs]]
t=time.monotonic();got=run(ops)
assert got['answers']==[131071]*131072 and got['loads']==[True]
print('maximum put / query counts passed in',time.monotonic()-t)
